# BEGIN CUSTOMER DEMO COORDINATION
For customer-demo setup, skinning, resume, or Sitecore content work:
1. Read .github/ai-boards/master-backlog.md and resolve the explicit customer slug.
   Load only that customer's board and referenced active-task checkpoint. Do not
   infer customer identity from the last chat, current browser tab, or default site.
2. Resolve the canonical coordinator locator through the common Git directory.
   Worktree board copies are snapshots. active_agent: None is NOT permission to write.
   If the coordinator is missing, parallel_writes_enabled is false, or scope cannot
   be verified, perform read-only planning and report the unmet prerequisite.
3. Before any mutation, acquire a coordinator-issued session claim for the customer
   and all affected resources. Use the assigned worktree and feature branch.
   Revalidate ownership, canonical paths and target Sitecore identity before every
   mutation batch. Stop on lost ownership. Never clear another session's lock.
4. Change only assigned paths and verified Sitecore roots. Preserve unrelated edits.
   Source Prospera, other customers, shared schema/designs, global build configuration,
   and serialization settings require their own explicitly scoped integration task.
   Never copy credentials, .env.local, caches, generated outputs or prior demo state
   from the source app. Follow repository rules for environment provisioning.
5. Keep existing setup-progress.yaml and customer demo-progress.yaml as the detailed
   workflow records. Reference them from the board; do not duplicate phase state.
   Track tasks by immutable customer-prefixed HTML-comment IDs, not line numbers.
6. Record remote mutation intent, returned IDs/jobs and read-back evidence. On an
   uncertain result, reconcile it before retrying. Documentation lookup is reference
   material; it does not prove tenant identity or authorize content mutations.
7. Checkpoint after meaningful work and before compaction or handoff: exact next
   file/item/action, validation evidence, unresolved jobs, dirty files and workers.
   Ask the coordinator to update with the expected board revision. At exit, stop
   owned workers, persist progress, and release only this session's claims.
8. Follow .github/ai-boards/prospera-integration-plan.md for the setup/build handoff.
   Do not assume instructions.md is loaded unless the actual skill entry point reads it.
# END CUSTOMER DEMO COORDINATION
